item.title: Scaling Europe Daily - 27.10.
item.content:encoded:
Hello and welcome back.

Funding rounds were the story again, with raises across several sectors and countries.

Let’s dive in.

💰 Funding rounds

  • Nevis raised €62M Series B to expand its AI agents for wealth advisers and grow its product and go-to-market teams. Read more here.

  • Cognitive Credit raised €35.73M strategic growth investment to expand in the US and build new AI products for credit analysis. Read more here.

  • Phononic Vibes raised €25M to expand its noise and vibration control technology internationally and into new areas like data centres and rail. Read more here.

  • Nous raised $17M to expand internationally and take its AI agent for household bills into more services like insurance and financial products. Read more here.

  • adsilico raised £10M Series A to develop its virtual heart models and expand into neurovascular devices. Read more here.

  • Volare raised €7.1M to build a second insect protein factory and expand across and beyond Europe. Read more here.

  • Sonexos raised around €5.4M to take its low-frequency noise reduction technology from prototype to industrial production. Read more here.

  • Epoch raised $4.25M seed to grow its product and commercial team helping small importers meet EU deforestation rules. Read more here.

  • Cygrid raised €2.66M pre-seed to grow its team and scale its tool that stops AI agents from accessing confidential company data. Read more here.

  • Intuitivo raised €1.35M seed to ease teachers’ workload and expand into Brazil. Read more here.

  • CHD raised €160K as part of its seed round to develop and validate its remote monitoring for high-risk pregnancies. Read more here.

🌱 Startup news

  • Helsing unveiled Contra, an AI-controlled air defence system against large-scale drone and missile attacks, alongside two new interceptors. Read more here.

💡 Other news

  • Alex Depledge is leaving her role as the UK Treasury’s entrepreneurship adviser after this week’s Budget. Read more here.

📣 Fund news

  • Eureka! Venture raised over €35M at first close for Z_One Fund, which will invest up to €250K in pre-seed and seed AI and UrbanTech startups. Read more here.

🤝 M&A

  • Veck was acquired by Evertrace to strengthen its early founder detection. Read more here.

Subscribe to the weekly edition for the highlights here.

item.title: Scaling Europe Daily - 2.10.
item.content:encoded:
Hello and welcome back.

Funding rounds were the story again, with raises across several sectors and countries.

Let’s dive in.

💰 Funding rounds

• Foundational raised €9.6m to develop infrastructure for a more precise understanding of Earth and orbit through satellite laser ranging technology that provides millimetre-level positioning data. Read more here.

• Osavul raised €8.5m Series A to grow enterprise clients and expand government and defence work with its artificial intelligence platform that identifies hostile activity including cyber threats and disinformation campaigns. Read more here.

• Deepslate raised €7.7m Seed to develop speech-to-speech artificial intelligence models that process spoken language directly with focus on European languages and data sovereignty. Read more here.

• FRANK raised €2.9m to develop its artificial intelligence powered platform that automates administrative tasks for insurance brokers by replicating human actions across insurance systems and portals. Read more here.

• Voltaback raised €2.8m to scale its fleet management software platform that helps companies reimburse employees for home electric vehicle charging across Europe. Read more here.

• Revnu raised €2.6m to build team and accelerate international growth with its artificial intelligence platform that helps businesses find customers and build their sales pipeline. Read more here.

• Good Tape raised funding to develop context layer that surfaces changing opinions and contradictions across years of recorded interviews. Read more here.

🌱 Startup news

• ElevenLabs expanded to the Netherlands with a new office in Amsterdam. Read more here.

📣 Fund news

• DIG Ventures closed €106m Fund III to back Europe’s artificial intelligence and cloud infrastructure startups. Read more here.

item.title: Scaling Europe Daily - 4.9.
item.content:encoded:
We’re moving the newsletter over to LinkedIn.

Nvidia officially confirmed it’s buying Hugging Face. Let’s dive in.

💰 Funding rounds

  • Milan-based Tensive received a €20m EIB convertible loan to fund research and development, clinical studies, CE marking, manufacturing scale-up and commercialisation readiness for REGENERA bioresorbable scaffolds for breast reconstruction and tissue marking. Read more here.

  • Munich-based Atira raised $17.5m Seed to automate industrial sales engineering for complex, built-to-order products. Read more here.

  • Munich-based Zeit AI raised €5m Seed to build the autonomous data engineer platform for European mid-market companies. Read more here.

  • Stafford-based Strolll raised €5m to advance augmented reality neurorehabilitation technology for clinical and home settings. Read more here.

  • Brussels-based Backbone raised €4m pre-Seed to build an AI platform for quality and compliance in the food industry. Read more here.

  • Cyprus-based Piney raised €1.6m to scale its cleaning and operations platform for short- and mid-term rental property managers globally. Read more here.

  • UK-based Rightcharge raised £500k to scale fleet EV charging payment solutions across Europe. Read more here.

🤝 M&A

  • Nvidia confirmed acquisition of France-founded Hugging Face for $12.93bn. Read more here.
